packageRules.description: Jellyfin's own packages pin the oldest server each target supports, which is a decision rather than a version to keep current. Directory.Build.props says why.
EF Core follows the server's own pin, not the newest release: the host provides the runtime assembly, and a plugin ahead of it fails to load.
Everything else that is only a build or test dependency can travel together.
An action pinned by tag is updated in place; a major is a behaviour change and gets its own pull request, since a green job does not prove the job still does its work.
